name: StruisICT SMTP Test Tool
free_limit: Free local CLI and GUI binaries for SMTP, IMAP and POP3 connectivity diagnostics, TLS/authentication testing, email DNS checks (MX/SPF/DMARC/DKIM), and optional Microsoft 365 OAuth; no software subscription, vendor-imposed usage quota or expiration.
watch_out: Local diagnostic tool, not a hosted SMTP relay or free mailbox. Requires access to existing mail servers and valid credentials; external mail-provider charges and rate limits still apply. Optional DNS and OAuth features depend on network access and Microsoft 365 permissions; some test actions interact with real mail systems.
